children: Senti Biosciences announced two financing actions to bolster liquidity ahead of its proposed merger. The company issued $2.0 million of Senior Secured Convertible Notes to NSG BioInnovation Fund under its existing purchase agreement, with documentation amended to add NSG. Separately, an affiliate of Celadon agreed to purchase $2.5 million of common stock at Nasdaq’s Minimum Price at or around merger closing, with customary registration rights to follow. The financings are intended to support transaction execution and ongoing operations.
Agreement 1: Senti Biosciences Raises $2 Million via Senior Secured Convertible Notes to NSG BioInnovation
: Senior Secured Convertible Notes issuance under Securities Purchase Agreement
: Strengthen liquidity ahead of proposed merger and operations
Agreement 2: Senti Biosciences Secures $2.5 Million Equity Commitment From Celadon Affiliate
: Equity Commitment Letter for common stock purchase at Nasdaq Minimum Price
: Provide equity funding to support merger closing and operations
